description: Per-character combat-VFX tuning: aura/disappearance colors, effect IDs for cursed-energy and tension level changes, Blueprint preload names, and per-technique effect scale/offset vectors (mostly through IGameActorInterface, with direct EffectRow reads for buff/debuff and weapon pinning).

ID.technical: FName primary key (export key ID, ImportKeyField=Id). Resolved by AGameCharacter::ResolveDataRows into Character::EffectRow (+0x3C8), by battle asset collectors (DTM +0x4D0) and by AGameShikigami::EffectRow (+0x348). None/missing rows produce nullptr in character/shikigami caches and are skipped by collectors; the exported CharacterDataTable has 48 rows (CP_160's effect id is shared by CP_160 and CN_260) and the two non-None ShikigamiDataTable references also resolve to these 47 rows. UpdateCursedEnergyAura dereferences the cached row without a null check.

bUseAuraEffectEnabled.simple: Whether this character participates in the cursed-energy aura slot system.
bUseAuraEffectEnabled.technical: bool, constructor default false; 46/47 exported rows (all except CN_240) set true. UpdateCursedEnergyAura returns before removing or spawning cursed-energy aura slots 0/1 when false. It does not gate cursed-energy level-up effect spawning or tension aura/level-up effects.

CursedEnergy_AuraColor.technical: FLinearColor, constructor default (1,1,1,1); exported values can exceed 1 (HDR, e.g. R=5.6, B=10). Applied with Niagara SetColorParameter('AuraColor') to cursed-energy level-up and slotted aura effects, to cursed-energy hit effects whose damage row qualifies (AGameCharacter::ApplyHitEffectAuraColors), and to CN_110's active waist aura; these tint sites null-check the row.

CursedEnergy_BrightAuraColor.simple: Niagara 'BrightAuraColor' parameter for the bright core of cursed-energy effects.
CursedEnergy_BrightAuraColor.technical: FLinearColor, constructor default (1,1,1,1), often HDR-bright in the export. Applied with SetColorParameter('BrightAuraColor') at the same cursed-energy level-up, slotted aura, qualifying hit-effect and CN_110 waist-aura sites.

Disappear_FogColor.simple: Niagara 'FogColor' parameter for the character's down/disappear effect.
Disappear_FogColor.technical: FLinearColor, default (1,1,1,1). FGameCharacterAction's down-end effect (FX_CP_000_17301) sets this color parameter on all its Niagara components from the owner's EffectRow.

Disappear_GlowColor.simple: Niagara 'GlowColor' parameter for the character's down/disappear effect.
Disappear_GlowColor.technical: FLinearColor, default (1,1,1,1), set on the same Niagara components as Disappear_FogColor at down-end.

Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_LevelUp.simple: Effect ID spawned when the cursed-energy level increases.
Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_LevelUp.technical: FName effect ID; 'None' is the sentinel for the built-in FX_CP_000_07112. On an increased cursed-energy level with bPlayEffect, a non-None value replaces that default and the spawned effect's Niagara components are tinted with the aura colors. Exported non-None values are CP_020 -> FX_CP_020_00312 and CP_060/CP_200 -> FX_CP_000_07312; all resolve in the exported EffectDataTable.

Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_Aura_2.simple: Effect ID for cursed-energy level 2 aura.
Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_Aura_2.technical: FName effect ID for cursed-energy level 2; 'None' falls back to FX_CP_000_07121 in effect slot 0. UpdateCursedEnergyAura first removes slots 0 and 1, and requires bUseAuraEffectEnabled. A Coercion buff stack overrides the selected ID with FX_CP_020_00341 for levels 2-4. Exported non-None values are CP_020 -> FX_CP_020_00321 and CP_060/CP_200 -> FX_CP_000_07321; all resolve in EffectDataTable.

Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_Aura_3.simple: Effect ID for cursed-energy levels 3 and 4 aura.
Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_Aura_3.technical: FName effect ID for cursed-energy levels 3 and 4; 'None' falls back to FX_CP_000_07131 in effect slot 1. Level 3/4 share the slot/ID, level 2 uses Aura_2, and Coercion overrides the selected ID with FX_CP_020_00341. Exported non-None values are CP_020 -> FX_CP_020_00331 and CP_060/CP_200 -> FX_CP_000_07331; all resolve in EffectDataTable.

Id_Effect_Tension_LevelUp.simple: Effect ID spawned when the tension level increases.
Id_Effect_Tension_LevelUp.technical: FName effect ID; no built-in default. On OldLevel < NewLevel a non-None value is passed to SpawnOwnerEffect(-1, id) after tension aura slot updates, with no Niagara color tinting. Only CP_060 sets it in the export (FX_CP_000_07212), which resolves in EffectDataTable.

Id_Effect_Tension_Aura_2.simple: Effect ID for tension level 2 aura.
Id_Effect_Tension_Aura_2.technical: FName effect ID for tension level 2; when non-None it is spawned in effect slot 2 after slots 2 and 3 are removed. No default ID and no bUseAuraEffectEnabled check; tension auras are not tinted with the cursed-energy color fields. Only CP_060 sets it in the export (FX_CP_000_07221), which resolves in EffectDataTable.

Id_Effect_Tension_Aura_3.simple: Effect ID for tension levels 3 and 4 aura.
Id_Effect_Tension_Aura_3.technical: FName effect ID for tension levels 3 and 4; when non-None it is spawned in effect slot 3 (the same slot for both levels). No default ID and no color tinting. Only CP_060 sets it in the export (FX_CP_000_07231), which resolves in EffectDataTable.

BuffDebuffEffectScale.simple: Scale applied to buff/debuff effect actors attached to this character.
BuffDebuffEffectScale.technical: FVector read directly from the owner's EffectRow (or the target's, in CN_250) and applied with SetActorScale3D to spawned buff/status effects, including CN_110's FX_CP_000_07121 waist aura and the status-controller attach helper. Several of these sites, including the status helper, dereference the row without a null check. Non-unit values occur in the export (e.g. CP_080, CN_040).

MapGroundEffectScale.simple: Scale for ground/map effects spawned by this character.
MapGroundEffectScale.technical: FVector exposed through IGameActorInterface overrides on AGameCharacter and AGameShikigami; action controllers, blow/jump actions, animation notifies and shikigami actions use it as actor scale or spawn-transform scale for ground/run/dash/jump effects. Base interface fallback is OneVector when there is no cached row or the actor has no override.

SimpleDomainCounterEffectScale.simple: Scale of the simple-domain counter hit effect.
SimpleDomainCounterEffectScale.technical: FVector exposed through IGameActorInterface overrides on AGameCharacter and AGameShikigami; CN_200 sets the counter hit effect's actor scale from CounterTarget's value. The interface default is OneVector for actors without an override or without this row.

CrimsonBindEffectScale.simple: Scale of Crimson Bind/restraint effects in projection sorcery.
CrimsonBindEffectScale.technical: FVector exposed through IGameActorInterface overrides on AGameCharacter and AGameShikigami; projection-sorcery actions apply it to both the binding (FX_CP_190_06201) and restraint effect actors with SetActorScale3D. Interface default is OneVector.

CrimsonBindEffectOffset.simple: Local offset of the Crimson Bind restraint effect.
CrimsonBindEffectOffset.technical: FVector exposed through IGameActorInterface; projection-sorcery code rotates it by FRotator(90, 0, -90) and applies it as the restraint effect's relative location. Interface default is ZeroVector; AGameShikigami does not override this getter.

ProjectionSorceryEffectScale.simple: Scale for projection-sorcery frame and shatter effects.
ProjectionSorceryEffectScale.technical: FVector exposed through IGameActorInterface; projection-sorcery actions apply it to spawned frame and shatter effect actors at multiple setup/shatter call sites. Interface default is OneVector; AGameShikigami does not override this getter.

ProjectionSorceryEffectOffset.simple: Offset of projection-sorcery frame effects relative to the owner's root rotation.
ProjectionSorceryEffectOffset.technical: FVector exposed through IGameActorInterface; ProjectionFrameTransform adds GetRootRotation().RotateVector(this value) to the owner's location when positioning frame effects. Interface default is ZeroVector; AGameShikigami does not override this getter.

ProjectionSorceryWeaponLocation.simple: Relative location used to pin weapon 0 during projection sorcery.
ProjectionSorceryWeaponLocation.technical: FVector read directly from Character::EffectRow; PinProjectionWeapon calls AGameWeapon::SetActorRelativeLocation with it when the character has a weapon at index 0. Unpin restores a zero offset. The direct read is not null-checked.

ProjectionSorceryWeaponRotation.simple: Relative rotation used to pin weapon 0 during projection sorcery.
ProjectionSorceryWeaponRotation.technical: FRotator read directly from Character::EffectRow (degrees for Pitch/Yaw/Roll); passed to AGameWeapon::SetActorRelativeRotation next to ProjectionSorceryWeaponLocation. Unpin restores zero rotation; the direct read is not null-checked.

FreezingRestraintEffectScale.technical: FVector exposed via IGameActorInterface; restraint actions apply it to the spawned freezing restraint effect actor with SetActorScale3D. Interface default OneVector; AGameShikigami does not override this getter.

FreezingRestraintEffectOffset.simple: Root-rotation-relative offset of freezing restraint effects.
FreezingRestraintEffectOffset.technical: FVector exposed via IGameActorInterface; restraint actions rotate it by the owner's root rotation before positioning the effect, then attach the effect to the mesh root keeping world transform. Interface default ZeroVector.

CentipedeRestraintEffectOffset.simple: Additional world offset for the centipede restraint/down effect.
CentipedeRestraintEffectOffset.technical: FVector exposed via IGameActorInterface (virtual slot +0x538); GameCharacterAction_Blow adds it to GetFallEffectOffset() when computing the centipede restraint/down effect location. Interface default ZeroVector.

FileName_BP.simple: Array of effect Blueprint asset names preloaded for this character.
FileName_BP.technical: TArray<FName>, row +0x1A8; all 47 exported rows contain exactly 48 entries with trailing 'None' padding. BattleAssets_CharacterEffects_12BC550 appends the whole array for each battle character; GamePrimaryAssetLoader_CreateLoaders builds Effect-primary asset loaders, ignoring None names and deduplicating them. The same collector feeds StudioCharacterEffectLoaders_8B0 in battle setup and StudioCharacterEffectLoaders_310 in battle preload. These names are preload asset IDs (813/814 unique non-None names match EffectDataTable.FileName_BP in the export); actual spawning uses separate Id_Effect_* EffectDataTable row IDs, not this array.

notes: Export contains 47 rows (CP/CN character IDs); every row serializes all fields. Color values are FLinearColor and can exceed 1.0 (HDR); the JSON export's Hex field is a display aid, not a separate property.

Character rows and shikigami rows both carry Id_CharacterEffect; AGameShikigami caches the row type at +0x348. In the export only CN_110 and CN_231 have non-None shikigami references. Shikigami overrides only the map-ground, simple-domain-counter-scale and Crimson Bind scale interface getters; other effect getters use base defaults for shikigami.

Most scale/offset fields are reached through IGameActorInterface virtuals (base OneVector/ZeroVector for unrelated actors and for null rows); BuffDebuffEffectScale and projection-sorcery weapon pinning read EffectRow directly. Some direct and status-helper sites do not null-check the row.

The row constructor explicitly initializes only bUseAuraEffectEnabled=false and the four colors to (1,1,1,1); vector/rotator/name-array members are not assigned there. All serialized rows supply explicit values, and interface OneVector/ZeroVector values are fallbacks for a null row, not row defaults.

Single table asset 'CharacterEffectDataTable' loaded into DTM +0x4D0; no numbered shards or locale variants in the export. All nine non-None Id_Effect_* targets and all built-in fallback effect IDs resolve in the exported EffectDataTable; one FileName_BP name, FX_CP_140_00101_BP, is not present as an EffectDataTable.FileName_BP value in the current export.

Reconstructed source with cited retail RVAs; interface getter names/slots and several behavioral attributions come from current reconstruction, not shipped symbols. No claim about Blueprint-only consumers, uncooked assets, or byte-identical matching.

usages.detail: Effect-primary loader creation drops None names and deduplicates the preload list built from FileName_BP.
Caches the row as AGameCharacter::EffectRow; interface getters at 2382-2468 fall back to OneVector/ZeroVector when it is null.
Aura gate and cursed-energy aura/level-up effect selection and tinting; the aura gate itself dereferences the row unguarded.
Tension aura level and level-up effect selection, independent of bUseAuraEffectEnabled.
Status-effect attachment scales the effect from the owner's EffectRow without a null check.
Qualifying cursed-energy hit effects are tinted with the owner's aura colors.
Active waist aura uses BuffDebuffEffectScale and both cursed-energy color fields.
Appends all FileName_BP entries (including None padding) for a battle character's effect-preload list.
Creates StudioCharacterEffectLoaders_310 from those names; battle setup also creates StudioCharacterEffectLoaders_8B0 via GamePhase_BattleBase.cpp:257/297.
Caches the same row type for shikigami; only map-ground, simple-domain-counter-scale and Crimson Bind scale getters are overridden (569, 579, 2215).
Projection frame placement uses the root-rotated projection effect offset; frame/shatter scales at 181/194/422/435 and weapon pinning at 104-110.
Freezing restraint effects use the root-rotated offset and scale getter.
